description: On the countertop in front of you are two black slipper-like pads, a white phone, a small blue cup, a yellow-green item, a box of paper clips, and a gray handheld tool lying on the right. The left hand stays near the left edge, lightly steadying the left pad, while the right hand reaches in from the right to grasp the gray tool, lifts it up and carries it leftward over the pads, then lowers and releases it onto the right pad.
